VEA.EdgeAttenuationHint: Controls how gradually vision fades into darkness at its maximum range.
VEA.LightEdgeAttenuationHint: Controls how gradually this light fades at its maximum range, independently of its native attenuation.
VEA.LightUnsupported: Vision Edge Attenuation: an incompatible light shader was detected. That source keeps its native lighting; see the console.
VEA.Unsupported: Vision Edge Attenuation: the visual effect is unavailable with this canvas pipeline. Token settings are preserved; see the console and README.
VEA.PersistentVision: Vision Edge Attenuation: persistent vision does not distinguish current sight from exploration. The visual effect is disabled for this scene.
